contradictions.issue: Router physical location (Cloud Supabase Edge vs Local Workstation)
contradictions.why: Routing must be split: client/local node evaluates deterministic and private tasks first; cloud edge orchestrates multi-agent cloud deliberators.

contradictions.issue: Supabase hard dependency vs Local-first standalone deployment
contradictions.why: Maestro's developer platform depends on Supabase tables and realtime; ripping it out breaks working builds. Decouple MaestroClaw worker rather than rewriting the database.

contradictions.issue: Council as primary product vs Council as rare escalation
contradictions.why: Models do not know when they fail. Gating multi-agent diversity strictly on model uncertainty allows overconfident cheap models to hallucinate uncaught.

contradictions.issue: Minimum sufficient intelligence routing vs Grading flywheel data starvation
contradictions.why: A multi-armed bandit explore/exploit approach is required. Sample a 5-10% background shadow council to keep the reputation engine continuously trained.

missing.why_it_matters: Models are systematically overconfident. Route escalation based on whether local tests and compilers pass, not model self-scores.
Solves the flywheel starvation problem by running multi-model evaluation in the background without user latency.

missing.idea: Schema-First Inversion (models as parameter extractors only)
missing.why_it_matters: In business workflows, models should never generate logic; they should strictly slot-fill parameters for deterministic pre-audited code.

new_race: The local, private operating system for verified domain workflows and grounded code delivery.

michael_is_wrong_about: Michael is wrong that expanding Maestro into dental offices, school boards, and homes is an intelligence routing problem. In those domains, the intelligence is trivial (a single database query), while verified data connectors, HIPAA/FERPA regulatory safeguards, and rigid schema validation are the entire product.
